title: access.json group_memberships
description: The group memberships of the person (table group_memberships), removed ones included, each with the ID and name of its group, who added the person and when, the expiry and the removal.

added_by.description: ID of the principal who added the person.

expires_at.description: End of the membership; absent when it does not expire.

removed_at.description: When the membership was removed; absent while it is not removed.

removed_by.description: ID of the principal who removed the person; absent when it is not removed or the server removed it (for example on an account deletion).
